thread:
marta: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a gateway strangulation for the legacy /v1 generate endpoints. Plan: route tenant traffic to /v2 by default over 12 weeks, soft opt-in via feature flag for the first 4 weeks. Need thoughts on telemetry, fatal edge cases, and whether we should ship a thin client adapter.

devon: +1 on strangulation pattern. Two concerns: 1) telemetry to detect client regressions, 2) avoiding expensive sidecars per-tenant. Suggestion: routing table at the gateway keyed by tenant id + feature flag windows (4w opt-in, 8w encouraged, 12w forced). Keep rollout in small cohorts.

kai: Leaning towards smaller waves. First rollout: shadow /v2 for 48h (no rewrite), then gradual rewrite 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100%. Instrument request/response diffs. Also propose a header for explicit fallback: `X-Rw-Compat: v1` so clients can opt out if they detect regressions.

samir: Streaming differences worry me. v1 sends framed chunks, v2 streams newline-delimited JSON objects. Gateway shimming to reframe adds CPU and latency risk on the hot path. Alternatives: 1) offer a tiny adapter lib customers can drop-in to translate streams client-side, 2) do non-streaming fallback at gateway (buffering) but only for low QPS tenants. Thoughts?

marta: Good call. For high-traffic tenants prefer adapter lib; for others gateway buffering fallback is OK but gated. Telemetry: we must record request shape, token delta, chunk count, and 95/99 latency pre- and post-rewrite.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary rollout at 1758420010. Will emit metric `compat_gateway.responses_rewritten`.

yuki: Add per-tenant kill switch + circuit breaker tied to error budget. Also run prompt-set evals during each wave and auto-trigger rollback if quality drop > threshold. Need a dashboard for regression alerts.

devon: Proposed routing rule (draft):

```
{
  "route": "/generate",
  "rewrite": {"from": "/v1/generate", "to": "/v2/generate"},
  "conditions": ["tenant.has_flag('compat_v2')"],
  "timeout_ms": 60000,
  "buffer_streaming": false
}
```

marta: Nice. Add TTL on feature flag so we don't accidentally leave tenants trapped. Also add telemetry tags: `tenant_id`, `cohort_wave`, `shim_mode`. Ops: please create the dashboards and a postmortem template if we hit >0.5% client errors after a wave.

samir: I'll own a lightweight adapter prototype (JS + Py) and run perf numbers vs gateway shim. Will post results in this thread.

kai: :thumbsup:

marta: Action items: 1) devon - finalize cohort list + feature flag TTL, 2) ops - dashboards + kill switch + alert playbook, 3) samir - adapter proto and perf, 4) marta - open RFC PR with timeline and rollback criteria. I'll schedule a 30m sync after canary.

marta: tagging this as follow-up from the RFC. Will include notes in the RFC PR.
